units.text: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, after years in which your chart went without it. From your mid-thirties, a partner stands with you on level ground and the household gives your strength a base. You meet the years of home on firmer feet, and the floor under them is your own.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, for a chart that ran short of it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties a partner met you as an equal, and the household made you sturdier. You learned to lean on yourself first and on others by choice.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, and your chart is short of it. Since your mid-thirties, a partner has backed you as a true equal and home has become the place your strength gathers. You walk out of your own door each morning surer of where you stand.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, though your chart is already flush with it. From your mid-thirties two strong wills share one household, and a partner who feels like an equal also feels like a contest. With an evening to yourself each week to cool off, you get further at home by giving way first.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, to a chart that held too much of it. Between your mid-thirties and late forties home was a place of strong wills and long standoffs, and you rarely backed down first. You got through on an hour's walk before each row set hard, and on cooling off before you spoke.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, in a chart that is already crowded with it. Since your mid-thirties, the household has felt like a contest of wills, with a partner as stubborn as you. Time apart for your own interests cools it down, and you are learning that yielding at home costs you nothing.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, with a chart that has long gone without it. From your late forties the people after you stand at your side, and what you have built gives you a firm floor. You grow surer of yourself with every year of it.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, and your chart has been hungry for it. Since your late forties, the people after you have stood behind you and what you built has started to hold its own weight. You stop asking permission for what is plainly yours to decide.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, on top of a chart already heavy with it. From your late forties you hold tight to what you have built, and the people after you want a hand on it too. Once you say no to the small fights, you keep your strength for the few that count.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, when your chart already overflows with it. Since your late forties you have guarded what you built closely, even from the people after you who want a hand in it. Passing the work into younger hands spends that strength well, and you are finding that a lighter grip holds more.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, the strength your chart had always lacked. From your late teens to your mid-thirties study and work put you among equals, and friends lent you the nerve you had been missing. You left that chapter able to stand up for yourself.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, at a time your chart is low on it. Since your late teens, friends and peers have stood beside you, and every rival has made you stronger rather than smaller. You stand your ground without first checking who agrees.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, for a chart already brimming with it. Between your late teens and mid-thirties friends doubled as rivals and you competed for every piece of work. With time alone at the end of each hard week, you grew tougher and choosier about your fights.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, into a chart that already runs over with it. Since your late teens, work has asked you to prove yourself and you push harder than any job needs. On the one slow day you keep each week, you learn where that strength is worth spending.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, when your chart was thin on it. Up to fifteen, children your age gave you someone to keep up with, in games you had to push your way into. You came out of that first home steadier on your own feet than you began.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, more of your own energy than your chart could hold. Through your school years you fought for your place among the children around you and rarely gave an inch. With an older relative who listened when you dug in, you learned to stand alone without standing against everyone.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is eager for it. From your mid-thirties home becomes a place of good food and music, with a partner who enjoys you at your liveliest. You make the household a warm place to come back to.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart blossomed under it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties home was lively, with a partner who laughed at your stories and a table set for guests. You came out of it knowing how to make a house feel like yours.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is warmed by it. Since your mid-thirties, home has been full of cooking, laughter and things you made with a partner. You let yourself enjoy things in these years without first earning them.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, an energy your chart does better without. From your mid-thirties your tongue is quick at home, and a partner hears more of your opinions than they asked for. You find the warmth comes back on a slow walk after dinner, when you listen more than you talk.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, in a chart that worked better without it. Between your mid-thirties and late forties you said what you thought at home and spent on whatever pleased you. Long quiet evenings let you talk yourself out, and you came away choosing your words with more care.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart cannot use all of it. Since your mid-thirties, appetite and opinion have filled the house, and a partner has borne the brunt of your restlessness. An hour of quiet each evening settles it, and you are learning to let them have the last word.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is ready for all of it. From your late forties, there is time and skill to make what is in your head, and the people after you learn by watching. You stop saving your ideas for later.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart sings with it. Since your late forties you have taught, performed or made things for the people after you, and they carry your style. You make things for the pleasure of it, with nothing left to prove.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, one that works against your chart. From your late forties you hold opinions on how the people after you live, and you voice them freely. With an hour alone each day to cool your views, you find they listen better when you say less.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, more than your chart can use. Since your late forties you have spent freely on pleasures and told the people after you exactly what you think. With a night between a thought and its saying, you find your words carry further when there are fewer of them.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart came alive with it. From your late teens to your mid-thirties you made things, spoke up and found friends who liked what you made. You came out of that chapter with a voice people recognised.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart has been waiting for exactly this. Since your late teens, what you make has found listeners at work and among friends who ask what comes next. You show your work before it is perfect, and it lands anyway.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, against the grain of your chart. Between your late teens and mid-thirties you spoke first, spent freely and chafed at every rule you had not written. Finishing one thing before you started the next carried you, and you left those years knowing which fights deserved your voice.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart has more than it can spend. Since your late teens your voice has outrun your position, and the people in charge have not always enjoyed it. You are learning that finished work speaks louder than talk, and that a day of silence before you object keeps your place.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart was glad of the outlet. Before you turned sixteen there were drawings, songs and stories, and the grown-ups at home clapped for every one of them. You came out of childhood sure that your voice was worth hearing.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, into a chart that pulled against it. As a child you talked back, tested every rule and wanted everything at once. With an older relative who heard you out before answering, you learned when to speak and when to wait.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart is ready for it. From your mid-thirties, home becomes a place to rest and think, with a partner who cares for you as much as you care for them. You recover there from whatever the rest of life asks.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart took all it could. Between your mid-thirties and late forties a partner looked after you, and home became the quiet place where you read and recovered. You left those years able to say what you need without apology.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart is grateful for it. Since your mid-thirties a partner has been your sounding board and home your place to read, rest and recover. You think things through out loud now, and the answers come quicker.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, an energy your chart does better without. From your mid-thirties, a careful partner and a quiet household make it easy to think things over too long. You keep the days moving by finishing one small thing before you plan the next.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, though your chart worked better without it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household was soft and settled, with every choice thought over twice. A practical project shared with a partner got you out of your head, and you left knowing that thinking needs a task.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, one that works against your chart. Since your mid-thirties, home has offered so much comfort and counsel that decisions wait, and a partner often thinks for you. You find you can trust your own judgement once you make one small decision a day alone.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart opens to it. From your late forties there is time at last to learn for pleasure, and the people after you come to you for advice. You become the one others think things through with.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart has needed it for years. Since your late forties, you have read more, rested better and found a patient voice with the people after you. You give good advice now because you finally take your own.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, against the pull of your chart. From your late forties, the people after you fuss over you more than you need and quiet days pile up. You stay sharp on a morning walk and one job finished before noon.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart holds more than it can use. Since your late forties you have been looked after and advised from every side, and what you built runs without much from you. You find a role beyond being cared for in small jobs done at your own pace.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart was thirsty for it. Between your late teens and your mid-thirties a teacher and an older hand at work vouched for you, and what you studied opened doors. You came out of those years well taught and well backed.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart welcomes every bit of it. Since your late teens, mentors and courses have found you at the right moments, and study has turned into standing. You learn in step with what you need, and nothing you study sits unused.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, into a chart that pulled the other way. From your late teens to your mid-thirties you studied long and waited longer, with more support around you than push. Once a friend asked what you were waiting for, you started to use what you knew.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart leans away from it. Since your late teens you have gathered qualifications and advice faster than chances to use them. You are learning to move before you feel ready, one small step a week.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart drank it in. Up to fifteen there were books and teachers and an older relative who made time to explain things. You came out of childhood with a habit of asking why that never left you.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart did better without it. Through your school years you were looked after closely, and others in your first home decided much for you. With afternoons outdoors on your own, you left childhood able to act as well as think.
